method.bodySpan: For each captured object, DRW_TableEntry::parseDwg was run over its retained bounded bytes. The parser cursor measured the common-header/EED end. ODA group 161 equals the source data span from that cursor to the declared object-data/handle-stream boundary minus its final zero bit. The adapter verifies that bit is zero before omitting it; group-310 bytes and the resulting significant span match ODA exactly.
method.references: Each source H entry was decoded from the bounded handle stream. Its role was mapped through DRW_ProxyObjectIdRef::dxfGroupCodeForDwgHandleCode and compared in order with ODA group-330/340/350/360 values. The common owner was compared separately. Null references were retained as zero-valued proxy references, not treated as resolved targets.
method.eed: The common EED was parsed independently and compared with ODA ordered XDATA groups. APPID handle references resolve to matching output APPID names. Coordinate-valued EED variants are normalized to their X/Y/Z DXF group triplets before comparison. ASCII coordinates are compared numerically with the measured maximum absolute delta above.
method.optionalFields: For this bounded AC1024 ACSH route, group 94 is emitted when proxy object-ID references are present and omitted when the reference list is empty, matching the ODA outputs. Generic proxy output is unchanged.
